article.limitation: The original full X article body was unavailable. The author newsletter and an explicitly linked resource-list witness establish a best-effort inventory, not a guarantee of every original hyperlink. Current collection members and one-level directory discoveries are classified separately.

reuse: Original synthesis and new implementation only. No upstream skill bodies, scripts, gated course files, or license terms are vendored. Review relevant licenses at an exact revision before any later copying. This registry does not select a license for this repository.
